arguments.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Monthly US Judiciary outlays from January 1984 to March 1987 (in millions)
# From treasury_bulletin_1985_03_page_22.txt (1984 data)
data_1984 = [84, 89, 63, 74, 62, 93, 65, 79, 69, 79, 67, 96]

# From treasury_bulletin_1986_03_page_26.txt (1985 data)
data_1985 = [66, 60, 59, 119, 75, 63, 74, 103, 66, 98, 74, 102]

# From treasury_bulletin_1987_03_page_24.txt (1986 data)
data_1986 = [76, 109, 74, 129, 75, 71, 70, 106, 87, 73, 73, 113]

# From treasury_bulletin_1988_03_page_36.txt (1987 Jan-Mar data)
data_1987 = [79, 76, 110]

# Combine all data from Jan 1984 to Mar 1987
all_data = data_1984 + data_1985 + data_1986 + data_1987

print(f"Number of months: {len(all_data)}")
print(f"Data: {all_data}")
print(f"Sum: {sum(all_data)}")
print(f"Arithmetic mean: {sum(all_data)/len(all_data):.3f}")

# Calculate geometric mean
# GM = (x1 * x2 * ... * xn)^(1/n)
# Using log: log(GM) = (1/n) * sum(log(xi))
log_sum = sum(math.log(x) for x in all_data)
geometric_mean = math.exp(log_sum / len(all_data))

print(f"Geometric mean: {geometric_mean:.6f}")
print(f"Geometric mean (rounded to thousandths): {geometric_mean:.3f}")
EOF
